description: This Java class implements a service for handling LwM2M OTA (Over-The-Air) updates, including firmware and software updates, for IoT devices within the Thingsboard platform. It manages update states, initiates firmware/software downloads, executes updates, and communicates with devices via CoAP requests.

classes.name: DefaultLwM2MOtaUpdateService
classes.description: Service class managing OTA firmware and software updates over LwM2M protocol, including state management, update initiation, and device communication.
